text:
Before: two English muffins with cheese (cheese melted/crisped), tea with milk, Greek yogurt tub (~100g?), blueberries (~40g). After: everything eaten; yogurt mostly eaten (residue in bowl and cup), tea drunk, butter/cream stick roll small.

Two English muffins, ~60g each = 120g, ~270 kcal. Cheese ~2 slices 40g = 160 kcal. Tea with milk ~300g, ~30 kcal. Yogurt ~150g Greek style ~ 200 kcal (Farmers Union Greek ~ 130kcal/100g); with residue, eaten ~130g = 170 kcal. Blueberries 50g = 28 kcal. The packet on the plate may be butter or Vegemite, perhaps ~10g, ~50 kcal.

Total: 270+160+30+170+28+50 ≈ 708 kcal. Mass: 120+40+300+130+50+10 = 650 g.
